answer: Here is one concrete wall: Hallowed sommelier registration with sommeliers society attestation. It works because a registration the society renews after cellar audits, and the ripple it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the terrace is that the farm's unit economics never work. The horizon is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
